scope:
What this shows: the frozen franken-atomic source, compiled for 32-bit big-endian MIPS and run as PID 1, produced exactly the
results the hand-written vectors and the independent Python reference require, including the per-seed history digests of
every scheduled run in both sweeps, and real threads got exact outcomes. What it does NOT show: the stock board kernel (this is the Debian
4.19 Malta kernel), true parallelism (QEMU's 24Kf is one CPU, so this is preemption), PowerPC, any physical board, or
behaviour under a futex implementation older than this kernel's. The naive-tear line is information only and is counted
nowhere. The reference and the Rust share an author; tests do not prove perfection.
